_comment: Update manifest. `web` is the latest web build — it MUST equal the ?v=N in index.html on every release (scripts/release.js writes both); js/update.js reads it fresh (no-store) and reloads the entry html so web/CSS/JS updates reach all devices without a reinstall. `apk` only triggers the in-app download banner when apk.build here is GREATER than the versionCode installed on the device. To release a NEW APK: bump android/app/build.gradle versionCode + versionName, `npm run sync`, build, commit the APK to download/THE-VAULT.apk, then set apk.build/apk.version here to the same numbers (scripts/check-contracts.js refuses a mismatch) and push.

apk.notes_ar: ودجت على الشاشة الرئيسيّة: تمرين اليوم وعدد حركاته، والسعرات والبروتين والماء بأشرطةٍ مقابل أهدافك — تُقرأ دون فتح التطبيق، وتُحدَّث مع كلّ حفظ. وتغييرٌ أمنيّ لا يُرى: كانت الحزم السابقة قابلةً للتنقيح، فكان تخزين المتصفّح داخلها مقروءًا عبر USB رغم تعطيل النسخ الاحتياطيّ؛ أُغلق هذا.
apk.notes_en: A home-screen widget: today's workout and its exercise count, plus calories, protein and water as bars against your goals — readable without opening the app, refreshed on every save. And one invisible security change: previous builds were debuggable, which made the WebView storage readable over USB despite backups being off. That is closed.
